title: transit IPv6 zone ID creates ambiguous peer identity in rate limiter
description: transit/peering/session.rs: peer_ip is SocketAddr::to_string() which includes IPv6 zone IDs (e.g., 'fe80::1%eth0'). Two peers on different interfaces with same zone ID could collide. Use SocketAddr.ip() directly as HashMap key. Also affects admin.rs RateLimiter independently.
